title: AES-Round Optimization for State Size 12 and Rate 2
summary: Six of seven proposed constructions were optimized; the state-size-12, rate-2 case remains to be optimized because one objective evaluation took half a day.

formal_statement.body: For $s=12$ and $\rho=2$, $\operatorname*{maximize}_{\mathrm{aes\_masks},\mathrm{feed\_masks},\mathrm{messages}} f(\mathrm{aes\_masks},\mathrm{feed\_masks},\mathrm{messages})$ over rate-valid constructions despite the cost of evaluating $f$.

scope.domain: Metaheuristic design of AES-round-based symmetric-key constructions using active-S-box bounds for internal-collision differential characteristics.
assumptions: The search is restricted to rate-valid constructions.
parameters: aes_masks, feed_masks, and messages: variables encoding a candidate construction
f: ILP-derived lower bound on active S-boxes in the best internal-collision differential characteristic
scope.unresolved_remainder: Carry out the omitted maximization of f over rate-valid constructions for state size 12 and rate 2.

citations.label: How to Use Metaheuristics for Design of Symmetric-Key Primitives

progress.summary: The paper reports optimizing six of seven constructions and omitting the state-size-12, rate-2 case because evaluating f once took half a day. It provides no optimization result for that case.
citation_labels: Ivica Nikolic et al., How to Use Metaheuristics for Design of Symmetric-Key Primitives
